title: [core] Support emitting ConEmu progress codes
description:
**IMPORTANT**: PRs without the template will be CLOSED
### Description of your *pull request* and other information
Implements outputting [ConEmu progress bar sequences](<https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/terminal/tutorials/progress-bar-sequences>) (tied to `--console-title`)

Fixes #10543

+

+class _ProgressState(enum.Enum):
+    """
+    Represents a state for a progress bar.
+
+    See: https://conemu.github.io/en/AnsiEscapeCodes.html#ConEmu_specific_OSC
+    """
+
+    HIDDEN = 0
+    INDETERMINATE = 3
+    VISIBLE = 1
+    WARNING = 4
+    ERROR = 2
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_dict(cls, s, /):
+        if s['status'] == 'finished':
+            return cls.INDETERMINATE
+
+        # Not currently used
+        if s['status'] == 'error':
+            return cls.ERROR
+
+        return cls.INDETERMINATE if s.get('_percent') is None else cls.VISIBLE
+
+    def get_ansi_escape(self, /, percent=None):
+        percent = 0 if percent is None else int(percent)
+        return f'\033]9;4;{self.value};{percent}\007'

review_comments.body: opted for this to simplify handling, and dedupe calculations. Will have to be implemented for postprocessor progress to be properly used

review_comments.author: pukkandan
review_comments.body: I don't like that this code is duplicated. Wouldn't it be better to pass `percent` and `state` to `to_console_title` instead?

review_comments.author: pukkandan
review_comments.body: Why this check? Where did you get these states? I don't remember there being an error state...

review_comments.author: Grub4K
review_comments.body:
https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/9f42e68a74f3f00b0253fe70763abd57cac4237b/README.md?plain=1#L2067-L2070
https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/9f42e68a74f3f00b0253fe70763abd57cac4237b/yt_dlp/YoutubeDL.py#L378-L382

I was following "Check this first and ignore unknown values". If it's inaccurate it should be adjusted first. `started`, as suggested below, is also none of the values advertised, which means it should be ignored.

review_comments.author: Grub4K
review_comments.body: On the other hand, I dislike adding more functionality to the `to_console_title` function... I do see the point though, as this is specifically tied to `--console-title`. If you think its better covered in there we can do that instead.

review_comments.author: pukkandan
review_comments.body:
Seems I forgot to update docs when hooks were added to PP.

As for "ignore unknown values", it's for future-proofing and only applies to third party code

review_comments.author: pukkandan
review_comments.body: I'd prefer that. Or atleast a new function. Having the logic in two places seems like a bad idea.

review_comments.author: Grub4K
review_comments.body: I see. I dont know these very well, so thats why I followed the docs lmao

review_comments.author: Grub4K
review_comments.body: If `started` differs from `downloading`, should I just watch for both and pass in the info dict? Or pass the `state` directly as a parameter?

`state` makes more sense than `status` imo. Or perhaps `is_error=s['status'] == 'error'`

Do you foresee us ever needing a state other than `1`/`2`?

review_comments.author: Grub4K
review_comments.body: yeah, we should probably apply `3` for postprocessors that do not supply progress?

So, I just had a quick look through code and only found `finished`, `downloading`, `started`. Maybe `error` was planned to be added but never finished? The docs are same since ytdl.

We might as well keep your support for error state though.
